description: This source file defines the `Env` class in Dart, which provides utilities for loading environment variables in a Flutter application. It handles loading environment variables either from bundled assets or from the file system, with fallback and error handling mechanisms.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class for managing environment variable loading in a Flutter application. It facilitates loading environment variables from assets or the file system with robust fallback strategies.

methods.name: load
methods.description: A static asynchronous method that attempts to load environment variables from the application's assets first, then from the file system if the first attempt fails. It includes error handling and debug print statements.
